slides.headline: What Microsoft won't say about Anthropic
Microsoft warns Anthropic AI risky
slides.body: On Sep 9, Microsoft said Anthropic's powerful AI could cause disastrous harm to humanity if unchecked.

slides.headline: AI could affect your daily life
slides.body: If AI safety fails, systems might make biased decisions in hiring, loans, or content you see online.

slides.headline: Microsoft may exaggerate the threat
slides.body: Some experts say the warning is meant to slow competition rather than reflect real danger.

slides.headline: Stay informed, demand transparency
slides.body: Follow AI news, ask companies how they test safety, and support rules that protect users.

slides.headline: Follow for AI safety
slides.body: Get clear, non‑tech updates on what AI means for you and your community.
